pages.text: After the waves retreated, wet sand sparkled. Riri and Lolo opened their eyes wide.
They wanted to find something shiny for Mom. "Let us give Mom a jewel from the sea!"
Riri stood at the end of the beach. Lolo started digging anywhere. "Search one row at a time." "If it shines, we will notice it."
Riri slowly searched one row. Shells, sticks, and more shells.
The first row was still not finished. A long line of footprints trailed behind Riri.
Lolo dug here and there. Lolo's pocket grew heavy.
Out came buttons and smooth pebbles. Nothing sparkled.
A big wave rolled in and receded. Lolo splashed into that spot, and blue light sparkled underfoot.
Riri followed the line and reached down. It was blue glass with all its edges worn round.
Mom put it on the windowsill. When sunlight came in, blue light reached the floor. Lolo placed the pebbles beside it.
